verdict.rationale: Region or data-residency choice is a fair question for a managed database platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents choosing a region when creating a project or database, or any residency guarantees. The only region mention is that the beta AI Gateway is available in AWS US East (Ohio) and AWS Europe (Frankfurt). That describes where one feature is offered, not user-selectable data storage location, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
